description: A test plan grounded in a project on this machine: its existing tests (read in full where related), the code the feature lives in, an optional git change and live pages, and the failures Tewip diagnosed there before. Returns risks, prioritised scenarios, what is already covered and what to automate next. Saves the plan in the project's .tewip/plans (nothing else is written). Needs OPENAI_API_KEY; takes about a minute.

diff.description: A git range whose change to plan for, e.g. "main...HEAD"

feature.description: What the feature does, in a sentence or two

project.description: Absolute path of the project folder

urls.description: Pages of the running app to read, e.g. ["http://localhost:3000/checkout"]

name: test_plan
title: Write a test plan for a feature
